values.note: Huron County Parks (one rate, no resident/non-resident split): electric or electric lakeview $42-45, full hookup $50, rustic $31 (whether RVs use the rustic field sites is not stated), rustic cabin $87; +$5 on holidays, $5 off in the off season. note: Huron County Parks campground on 120 acres at 7320 Lighthouse Rd, ~6 mi N of Port Hope on Lake Huron, at the historic Pointe aux Barques Lighthouse. Full-hookup loops to the south (many seasonal), electric sites to the north, both with lakefront rows; rustic sites in a field; 6 rustic cabins. Boat launch, fishing breakwater. Rocky, stony shore, not ideal for swimming; Wi-Fi unreliable under the trees. --Claude
